facts.claim: Per-firm payout breakdown given by JJ in 'The Strategy Behind My $1.6M': Topstep $292,000 (plus ~$50K on the old dashboard), E8 $222,000, Funded Engineer $180,000, Funded Next $129,500, Lucid ~$105,000, My Funded Futures $92,000. Also two early Topstep payouts of $4,500 each.

facts.claim: 'The Strategy Behind My $1.6M' (JJ's own video): goal of at least 10 trades per day in NY AM; 2-week sample of 80 trades over 8 days at 57.5% WR; A+/A/B setup grading; aggressive risk to get funded, conservative to stay funded; cycles one trade across many funded accounts; ends AM trading at 11:00.
facts.quote: getting in at least 10 trades per day on New York AM

facts.claim: 'Here's How You Can Make $100,000 Per Month On Prop Firms' / 'How Poker Math Made Me $100K/Month Trading Prop Firms' (nvOaN6mRu-o, ~2026-09-30): JJ's EV framework - cost-to-funded = eval fee / pass rate (e.g. $100 / 0.30 = ~$333); EV = P(payout) x payout size; scale multiple funded accounts to $100K/month.
facts.quote: JJ calculates cost to funded by dividing the evaluation fee by the pass rate. For example, if an eval costs $100 and the pass rate is 30%, the cost to get funded is $100 divided by 0.3, which equals approximately $333.
facts.source_title: sozai.app transcript: Here's How You Can Make $100,000 Per Month On Prop Firms

facts.claim: JJ's 'cost per drawdown' rule: a firm charging $16.6 per $1 of drawdown is the example; if cost per drawdown exceeds 50 cents it is 'generally not profitable' / the drawdown 'will trail 10 times'.
facts.quote: if you give a prop firm $16.6, they give you $1 worth of drawdown, and if your cost per drawdown is greater than 50 cents, your drawdown will trail 10 times

contradictions: The Captain Green podcast 'JJ Simon' is a Singapore waste-management official (Jonah Joshua Simon), not the trader; the task brief's appearance list is wrong on this item.
The 'Trading Nut' JJ (Dynamic Traders Club, 25,000 chart hours) and the AOL 'Kane Simons' article are different people; neither is an appearance by JJ Simon.
Trades per day: ~10 (JJ's own $1.6M video) vs 20+ (Words of Rizdom, Titans chapter) vs 30 (Chart Fanatics title). Probably reflects scaling across more accounts over 2026, but unreconciled.
Payout totals differ across platforms at the same time: Instagram $1.5M, TikTok $1.8M, YouTube/website $2M+ (Oct 2026).

Experience: '16 months' at $1.5M (mid-2026) vs Words of Rizdom '$1.8M in 18 months' - consistent only if the start is ~Feb-Mar 2025; the X post about graduating at 19 and 'turning down an industry offer' implies trading began right after graduation.

The per-firm breakdown ($292K + $222K + $180K + $129.5K + $105K + $92K = ~$1.02M, plus ~$50K old Topstep) sums to ~$1.07M, well short of the $1.6M headline of the same video; the remainder is unexplained (Tradeify, Tick Tick Trader, FFF, Bulenox, LFF are named elsewhere without amounts).
The task brief lists 'The Genius Who Outsmarted The Prop Firm Game' and 'Titans of Tomorrow' as separate appearances; they are the same episode (YouTube vs audio title).
